title: PPG-WIRE-MS0 — Wire JM Die master post engines + frontend wizard to camDispatcher
description: Wires the JM Die canonical master post engines (Hurco V11 mill, Okuma B250 lathe, Mitsubishi MV1200R wire EDM) and the post-processor wizard frontend (PostProcessorGeneratorPage + PhysicsDetailsPanel) to the camDispatcher action surface. Without this envelope the master post engines existed as standalone TypeScript classes but no MCP action could invoke them, so the post-processor wizard could not generate code on real customer hardware. PPG-WIRE-MS0 closes that gap end-to-end: dispatcher schema → action handler → REST route → web API client → wizard UI → physics overlay.
rationale: PSAU-PPG-SFC delivered the closed-loop substrate (provenance, outcome capture, inference gates, RAG warm-start, drift canary, ProtoMAML new-material). PPG-WIRE-MS0 is the orthogonal capability axis — turning on the actual G-code emission path for the 3 highest-volume JM Die machine families. Without this work, every closed-loop signal in PSAU-PPG-SFC has nothing to emit through.
leverage_existing: HurcoV11MillMasterPostEngine — 9 operation types, UltiMotion, G65 conversational macros, TSC coolant
OkumaB250LatheMasterPostEngine — Okuma OSP-P300L lathe, sub-spindle, live tooling, C-axis
MitsubishiMV1200RWireEDMMasterPostEngine — M700V/M800 dialects, 5-pass skim, taper, no-core
PostProcessorFeedOptimizerEngine — feed optimization with chatter + tool life propagation
camDispatcher action enum + Zod schema layer (mcp-server/src/schemas/camActionSchemas.ts)

the_worked_example_that_proves_it.scenario: Programmer at JM Die loads a D2 die plate program for the Mitsubishi MV1200R and clicks 'Generate' in the post processor wizard. Operations: 4 skim passes profile + taper finish.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.today_pre_ppg_wire: Wizard renders, but 'Generate' has no dispatcher route to the master post engine. The standalone MitsubishiMV1200RWireEDMMasterPostEngine class exists and has tests, but cannot be reached from MCP. Programmer falls back to manual editing.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.should_be_post_ppg_wire: POST /ppg/master/mitsubishi-mv1200r → master_post_mitsubishi_mv1200r action → engine.generateProgram() → M700V dialect G-code returned with full physics overlay (chatter stability lobes, tool life, Kienzle force estimate) shown in PhysicsDetailsPanel. Programmer accepts/edits → outcome captured by PSAU-PPG-SFC closed loop.
the_worked_example_that_proves_it.gap_now_closed: 10 of 11 PPG-WIRE units are shipped. Remaining: U-PPGW10 — Hurco V11 case in master_post_by_machine auto-router (currently the auto-router only branches OKUMA + MITSUBISHI, even though Hurco V11 exists as its own case).
